papers.title: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 (BNSS)
papers.description: Arrest procedures, custody, summons, charge sheet, trial procedures under BNSS 2023

papers.title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023 (BNS)
papers.description: Offences against body, property, state, public tranquility under BNS 2023

papers.title: Central Minor Acts and Special Laws
papers.description: NDPS Act, POCSO Act, Arms Act, Motor Vehicles Act, Excise & Local Acts

papers.title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023 (BSA)
papers.description: Admissibility, electronic evidence, burden of proof, expert witness under BSA 2023

papers.title: Forensics
papers.description: Crime scene examination, ballistics, biology, DNA, fingerprint science, toxicology

papers.title: ICT and Cyber Investigation
papers.description: Cyber forensics, CDR/IPDR analysis, financial fraud, social media investigation

papers.title: Criminology and Crime Prevention
papers.description: Theories of crime, criminal psychology, juvenile delinquency, surveillance, preventive policing

papers.title: Police Organization and Administration
papers.description: Organizational hierarchy, command structure, police manuals, disciplinary regulations

papers.title: Police Station Management
papers.description: GD entries, FIR registration, malkhana management, lockup rules, station records

papers.title: Personal Development
papers.description: Leadership, stress management, public speaking, conflict resolution, mental fitness

papers.title: Internal Security and Public Order
papers.description: Riot control tactics, mob dispersal, VIP security, intelligence collection, counter-insurgency

papers.title: Ethics and Accountability
papers.description: Police integrity, anti-corruption norms, human rights, custodial ethics, constitutional values

papers.title: Practical (Hands on)
papers.description: Moot courts, crime scene simulations, CCTNS live entry, mob control drills, case diary drafting
